title: Lions' Aidan Hutchinson says his jumping celebration days are over after torn ACL: 'That's the last time I go airborne'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Lions' Aidan Hutchinson says his jumping celebration days are over after torn ACL: 'That's the last time I go airborne'
sources.description: Hutchinson suffered the torn ACL while jumping up to celebrate sacking Patriots QB Drake Maye in Detroit's 35-10 win.
